description.p: lmdv is a native Linux Markdown viewer and editor built with Rust and Rune. It renders CommonMark, GFM tables and task lists, footnotes, GitHub callouts, front matter, Mermaid diagrams and TeX math without a webview or a browser engine.

Documents open in a distraction-free reader that remembers the reading position. Editing is an explicit mode; files are written only when you save, line endings and the byte-order mark are preserved, and unsaved changes are never silently replaced by a change on disk.
HTML, DOCX and PDF export work offline and never upload a document.
First packaging preview: desktop entry, AppStream metadata, AppImage, Flatpak and AUR recipes.
